name: compl_def
statement: lemma compl_def : aᶜ = a | a
proof: := rfl

name: meredith
statement: lemma meredith : a | b | aᶜ = a
proof:
:= by
  have l1 := veroff (a | b) a (b | a)
  rw [veroff a b a, comm _ a, comm _ a] at l1
  have l2 := veroff a a (a | b)
  rwa [l1, comm] at l2

name: compl_compl
statement: lemma compl_compl : aᶜᶜ = a
proof: := meredith a a

name: ababc
statement: lemma ababc : a | (b | (a | (b | c))) = a | (b | c)
proof:
:= by
  have l1 := veroff a (b | c) bᶜ
  rw [meredith, comm _ b] at l1
  have l2 := veroff (a | (b | c)) b a
  rwa [l1, comm, comm _ b] at l2

name: abba
statement: lemma abba : a | b | b | a = aᶜ
proof:
:= by
  have l1 := (ababc a (a | b) b).symm
  rwa [comm _ b, veroff, comm a, comm b] at l1

name: aba_abb
statement: lemma aba_abb : a | (b | a) = a | bᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ababc, comm b, comm _ (b | a), abba]

name: sheffer
statement: lemma sheffer : a | (b | bᶜ) = aᶜ
proof:
:= by
  have l1 := veroff a (b | b | b) b
  rw [abba, ← aba_abb, ← compl_def, comm _ (b | a), comm b] at l1
  have l2 := veroff (a | (b | bᶜ)) (a | (b | bᶜ | (b | (bᶜ | b)))) a
  nth_rw 1 [veroff a, veroff, comm _ bᶜ, l1] at l2
  exact l2.symm

name: le_def
statement: lemma le_def : a ≤ b ↔ aᶜ = a | b
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: le_sup_left
statement: lemma le_sup_left : a ≤ aᶜ | bᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def]
  have l1 := (meredith aᶜ bᶜ).symm
  rwa [compl_compl, comm] at l1

name: inf_le_left
statement: lemma inf_le_left : (a | b)ᶜ ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def, compl_compl]
  have l2 := (meredith (a | b) aᶜ).symm
  rwa [meredith a, comm _ _ᶜ] at l2

name: sup_le
statement: lemma sup_le (h₁ : a ≤ c) (h₂ : b ≤ c) : aᶜ | bᶜ ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [h₂]
  have l1 := (abba (aᶜ | (b | c)) (b | c | c)).symm
  rw [comm _ (aᶜ | _), ← le_def] at l1
  convert l1
  have l2 := veroff (b | c) c a
  rw [comm _ a, ← h₁, comm, comm _ aᶜ] at l2
  nth_rw 1 [l2, comm (b | c) c, comm b, veroff]

name: compl_le_compl
statement: lemma compl_le_compl (h : a ≤ b) : bᶜ ≤ aᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def, compl_compl]
  have l1 := (meredith b a).symm
  rwa [comm b, ← h, comm] at l1

name: compl_le_compl_iff_le
statement:
lemma compl_le_compl_iff_le : aᶜ ≤ bᶜ ↔ b ≤ a where
  mp h
proof:
:= by simpa only [compl_compl] using compl_le_compl _ _ h
  mpr h := compl_le_compl _ _ h

name: sup_def
statement: lemma sup_def : a ⊔ b = aᶜ | bᶜ
proof: := rfl

name: inf_def
statement: lemma inf_def : a ⊓ b = (a | b)ᶜ
proof: := rfl

name: f_compl_const
statement: lemma f_compl_const : a | aᶜ = b | bᶜ
proof:
:= by
  have l1 := meredith (b | bᶜ) a
  rwa [← sheffer (b | bᶜ) a, comm _ (a | aᶜ), sheffer, ← compl_compl (_ | a),
    ← sheffer (_ | a)ᶜ a, comm _ (a | aᶜ), meredith] at l1

name: sup_compl_eq_top
statement: lemma sup_compl_eq_top : a ⊔ aᶜ = top
proof: := f_compl_const aᶜ default

name: compl_inf
statement: lemma compl_inf : (a ⊓ b)ᶜ = aᶜ ⊔ bᶜ
proof: := by simp_rw [inf_def, sup_def, compl_compl]

name: le_iff_compl_sup
statement: lemma le_iff_compl_sup : a ≤ b ↔ aᶜ ⊔ b = top
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def, sup_def, compl_compl]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · have l1 : a | aᶜ = a | (a | b) := congrArg (a | ·) h
    rw [f_compl_const a default, comm _ b, aba_abb] at l1
    exact l1.symm
  · rw [← sup_compl_eq_top a, sup_def, compl_compl] at h
    have l1 := veroff (a | b) aᶜ a
    rwa [meredith, ← h, compl_def, veroff] at l1

name: eq74
statement: lemma eq74 : a | (a | a | a) = a | a
proof:
:= by
  have l1 := rule (a | (a | a | a)) (a | (a | a | a)) a
  have l2 := rule a a (a | a | a | (a | (a | a | a) | (a | a | a) | (a | a | a)))
  have l3 := rule (a | a | a) (a | (a | a | a)) a
  rw [rule a a (a | a)] at l1 l3
  rw [l3] at l2
  rwa [l2, eq_comm] at l1

name: eq75
statement: lemma eq75 : a | (a | a | a) | (a | a) = a
proof:
:= by
  have := rule a a (a | a)
  nth_rw 2 [eq74 a] at this
  exact this

name: eq76
statement: lemma eq76 : a | a | (a | (b | a)) = a
proof:
:= by
  have := rule a a b
  rwa [eq74 a] at this

name: eq77
statement: lemma eq77 : a | (b | b | a | a) | b = b | b
proof:
:= by
  have l1 := rule a (b | b) (a | b | (b | (a | b | b) | (a | b) | (a | b)))
  have l2 := rule (a | b) (b | (a | b | b)) a
  rw [rule b a a] at l2
  rwa [l2, eq76 b (a | b)] at l1

name: eq79
statement: lemma eq79 : a | (b | a | (b | a) | a | a) = b | a
proof:
:= by
  have := rule (b | a) (a | (b | a | (b | a) | a | a)) (b | a | (b | a))
  rwa [rule a (b | a | (b | a)) b, eq77 a (b | a), eq75 (b | a), eq_comm] at this

name: eq80
statement: lemma eq80 : a | a | (b | a) = a
proof:
:= by
  have := eq76 a (b | a | (b | a) | a)
  rwa [eq79 a b] at this

name: eq84
statement: lemma eq84 : a | b | (a | b) | b = a | b
proof:
:= by
  have := eq80 (a | b) (b | b)
  rwa [eq80 b a] at this

name: eq85
statement: lemma eq85 : a | (b | a | a) = b | a
proof:
:= by
  have := eq79 a b
  rwa [eq84 b a] at this

name: eq89
statement: lemma eq89 : a | (a | b | (c | b)) = a | b
proof:
:= by
  have l1 := rule (a | (c | b)) (a | b) (c | b | (c | b))
  have l2 := rule b a c
  rw [eq85 b a] at l2
  rwa [eq85 (a | (c | b)) (a | b), l2, eq80 (c | b) a] at l1

name: eq91
statement: lemma eq91 : a | (b | a | a) = a | b
proof:
:= by
  have := (eq89 a (b | a | a) b).symm
  rwa [rule a b (b | a)] at this

name: comm
statement: theorem comm : a | b = b | a
proof: := eq91 a b ▸ eq85 a b

name: Box.lower_lt_upper
statement: lemma Box.lower_lt_upper₁ : J.lower₁ < J.upper₁
proof: := J.lower_lt_upper 0

name: Box.le_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Box.le_iff₁ : J ≤ J' ↔ J'.lower₁ ≤ J.lower₁ ∧ J.upper₁ ≤ J'.upper₁
proof:
:= by
  simp [Box.le_iff_bounds, Pi.le_def, lower₁, upper₁]

name: interval_lower
statement:
@[simp]
lemma interval_lower (hab : a < b) : (interval hab).lower₁ = a
proof: := rfl

name: interval_upper

@[simp]
lemma interval_upper (hab : a < b) : (interval hab).upper₁ = b
proof: := rfl

name: Icc_interval
statement:

lemma Icc_interval (hab : a < b) : Box.Icc (interval hab) = {x | x 0 ∈ Set.Icc a b}
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Box.Icc_def, interval, Pi.le_def]

name: incrementAux_apply
proof: := rfl

name: increment_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma increment_apply (g : ℝ → M) (J : Box (Fin 1)) : increment g J = g J.upper₁ - g J.lower₁
proof: := rfl

name: increment_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma increment_smul {R : Type*} [Monoid R] [DistribMulAction R M] (c : R) (g : ℝ → M) :
    increment (c • g) = c • increment g
proof: := by ext J; simp [smul_sub]

name: increment_lsmul_eq_volume
statement:
lemma increment_lsmul_eq_volume {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] :
    increment (fun x : ℝ ↦ (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E) x) =
      (BoxAdditiveMap.volume : (Fin 1) →ᵇᵃ E →L[ℝ] E)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [volume_apply, Box.upper₁, Box.lower₁]; module

name: HasStieltjesIntegral.of_eq_iff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma HasStieltjesIntegral.of_eq_iff_zero : HasStieltjesIntegral a a B f g L ↔ L = 0

name: HasStieltjesIntegral.of_lt
statement:
lemma HasStieltjesIntegral.of_lt (hab : a < b) :
    HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f g L ↔ HasStieltjesIntegralOrdered a b B f g L hab
proof:
:= by
  simp [HasStieltjesIntegral, hab, hab.ne]

name: HasStieltjesIntegral.of_gt
statement:
@[simp]
lemma HasStieltjesIntegral.of_gt (hba : b < a) :
    HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f g L ↔ HasStieltjesIntegralOrdered b a B f g (-L) hba
proof:
:= by
  simp [HasStieltjesIntegral, hba.asymm, hba.ne.symm]

name: HasStieltjesIntegral.symm_iff
statement:
lemma HasStieltjesIntegral.symm_iff :
    HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f g L ↔ HasStieltjesIntegral b a B f g (-L)
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasStieltjesIntegral
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | rfl | h
  · simp [h, h.asymm, h.ne, h.ne.symm]
  · simp
  simp [h, h.asymm, h.ne, h.ne.symm]

name: HasStieltjesIntegral.symm
statement:
@[symm]
lemma HasStieltjesIntegral.symm (h : HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f g L) :
    HasStieltjesIntegral b a B f g (-L)
proof: := by rwa [← symm_iff]

name: stieltjesIntegrable_iff_integrable_of_lt
statement:
theorem stieltjesIntegrable_iff_integrable_of_lt (hab : a < b) :
    StieltjesIntegrable a b B f g ↔
    Integrable (interval hab) IntegrationParams.Riemann (f <| · 0)
      (.increment (B.flip <| g ·))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [StieltjesIntegrable, HasStieltjesIntegral, hab.ne, ↓reduceDIte, hab, Fin.isValue]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨_, hL⟩ ↦ HasIntegral.integrable hL, fun h ↦ ⟨_, h.hasIntegral⟩⟩

name: StieltjesIntegrable.of_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma StieltjesIntegrable.of_eq : StieltjesIntegrable a a B f g
proof:
:= by
  simp [StieltjesIntegrable, HasStieltjesIntegral]

name: StieltjesIntegrable.symm_iff
statement:
lemma StieltjesIntegrable.symm_iff :
    StieltjesIntegrable a b B f g ↔ StieltjesIntegrable b a B f g
proof:
:= by
  unfold StieltjesIntegrable
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨L, h⟩ <;> exact ⟨-L, h.symm⟩

name: StieltjesIntegrable.symm
statement:
@[symm]
lemma StieltjesIntegrable.symm (h : StieltjesIntegrable a b B f g) :
    StieltjesIntegrable b a B f g
proof: := by rwa [← symm_iff]

name: stieltjesIntegrable_iff_integrable_of_gt
statement:
theorem stieltjesIntegrable_iff_integrable_of_gt (hab : b < a) :
    StieltjesIntegrable a b B f g ↔
    Integrable (interval hab) IntegrationParams.Riemann (f <| · 0)
      (.increment (B.flip <| g ·))
proof:
:= by
  rw [StieltjesIntegrable.symm_iff, stieltjesIntegrable_iff_integrable_of_lt hab]

name: StieltjesIntegrable.iff_min_max
statement:
lemma StieltjesIntegrable.iff_min_max :
    StieltjesIntegrable a b B f g ↔ StieltjesIntegrable (min a b) (max a b) B f g
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with h | h <;> simp [h, symm_iff]

name: HasStieltjesIntegral.unique
statement:
theorem HasStieltjesIntegral.unique
    (h₁ : HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f g L₁) (h₂ : HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f g L₂) :
    L₁ = L₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | rfl | h
  · simp only [h, of_lt] at h₁ h₂
    exact HasIntegral.unique h₁ h₂
  · simp_all
  symm at h₁ h₂
  simp only [h, of_lt] at h₁ h₂
  exact neg_injective (HasIntegral.unique h₁ h₂)

name: HasStieltjesIntegral.stieltjesIntegrable
statement:
theorem HasStieltjesIntegral.stieltjesIntegrable
    (h : HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f g L) : StieltjesIntegrable a b B f g

name: StieltjesIntegrable.hasStieltjesIntegral
statement:
theorem StieltjesIntegrable.hasStieltjesIntegral (h : StieltjesIntegrable a b B f g) :
    HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f g ∫ˢ x in a..b, f x ∂[B; g]
proof:
:= by
  simp [stieltjesIntegral, h, h.choose_spec]

name: HasStieltjesIntegral.stieltjesIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem HasStieltjesIntegral.stieltjesIntegral_eq
    (h : HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f g L) : ∫ˢ x in a..b, f x ∂[B; g] = L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [stieltjesIntegral, dite_eq_left h.stieltjesIntegrable]
  exact h.stieltjesIntegrable.choose_spec.unique h

name: StieltjesIntegrable.hasStieltjesIntegral_iff
statement:
theorem StieltjesIntegrable.hasStieltjesIntegral_iff (h : StieltjesIntegrable a b B f g) (L : G) :
    HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f g L ↔ ∫ˢ x in a..b, f x ∂[B; g] = L
proof:
:= by
  grind [hasStieltjesIntegral, HasStieltjesIntegral.unique]

name: stieltjesIntegral.integral_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stieltjesIntegral.integral_same : ∫ˢ x in a..a, f x ∂[B; g] = 0
proof:
:=
  HasStieltjesIntegral.of_eq_iff_zero.mp StieltjesIntegrable.of_eq.hasStieltjesIntegral

name: stieltjesIntegral.integral_undef
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stieltjesIntegral.integral_undef (h : ¬StieltjesIntegrable a b B f g) :
    ∫ˢ x in a..b, f x ∂[B; g] = 0
proof: := by simp [stieltjesIntegral, h]

name: stieltjesIntegral.integral_symm
statement:
theorem stieltjesIntegral.integral_symm :
    ∫ˢ x in b..a, f x ∂[B; g] = -∫ˢ x in a..b, f x ∂[B; g]
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h_integ : StieltjesIntegrable a b B f g
  · exact (h_integ.hasStieltjesIntegral.symm.unique h_integ.symm.hasStieltjesIntegral).symm
  have h_integ_symm : ¬ StieltjesIntegrable b a B f g := by contrapose! h_integ; exact h_integ.symm
  simp [stieltjesIntegral, h_integ, h_integ_symm]

name: hasStieltjesIntegral'_congr
statement:
theorem hasStieltjesIntegral'_congr (hab : a < b) (hBB' : B = B')
    (hf : Set.EqOn f₁ f₂ (.Icc a b)) (hg : Set.EqOn g₁ g₂ (.Icc a b)) :
    HasStieltjesIntegralOrdered a b B f₁ g₁ L hab ↔
    HasStieltjesIntegralOrdered a b B' f₂ g₂ L hab
proof:
:= by
  subst hBB'
  unfold HasStieltjesIntegralOrdered
  apply BoxIntegral.hasIntegral_congr
  · intro x hx; exact hf (by simpa [hab] using hx)
  intro J hJ
  simp only [Set.mem_Iic, Box.le_iff₁, interval_lower, interval_upper,
    BoxAdditiveMap.increment_apply] at hJ ⊢
  have := J.lower_lt_upper₁
  congr 2 <;> exact hg (by grind)

name: hasStieltjesIntegral_congr
statement:
theorem hasStieltjesIntegral_congr (hBB' : B = B')
    (hf : Set.EqOn f₁ f₂ (.uIcc a b)) (hg : Set.EqOn g₁ g₂ (.uIcc a b)) :
    HasStieltjesIntegral a b B f₁ g₁ L ↔ HasStieltjesIntegral a b B' f₂ g₂ L
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with hab | rfl | hab
  · simp only [hab.le, Set.uIcc_of_le, hab, HasStieltjesIntegral.of_lt] at hf hg ⊢
    exact hasStieltjesIntegral'_congr hab hBB' hf hg
  · simp
  · simp only [HasStieltjesIntegral.symm_iff (a := a) (b := b), hab.le, Set.uIcc_of_ge, hab,
      HasStieltjesIntegral.of_lt] at hf hg ⊢
    exact hasStieltjesIntegral'_congr hab hBB' hf hg

name: stieltjesIntegrable_congr
statement:
theorem stieltjesIntegrable_congr (hBB' : B = B')
    (hf : Set.EqOn f₁ f₂ (.uIcc a b)) (hg : Set.EqOn g₁ g₂ (.uIcc a b)) :
    StieltjesIntegrable a b B f₁ g₁ ↔ StieltjesIntegrable a b B' f₂ g₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [StieltjesIntegrable, hasStieltjesIntegral_congr hBB' hf hg]

name: stieltjesIntegral_congr
statement:
theorem stieltjesIntegral_congr (hBB' : B = B')
    (hf : Set.EqOn f₁ f₂ (.uIcc a b)) (hg : Set.EqOn g₁ g₂ (.uIcc a b)) :
    ∫ˢ x in a..b, f₁ x ∂[B; g₁] = ∫ˢ x in a..b, f₂ x ∂[B'; g₂]
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : StieltjesIntegrable a b B f₁ g₁
    <;> have h' := h <;> rw [stieltjesIntegrable_congr hBB' hf hg] at h'
  · apply h.hasStieltjesIntegral.unique
    simp [hasStieltjesIntegral_congr hBB' hf hg, h'.hasStieltjesIntegral]
  simp [stieltjesIntegral, h, h']

name: HasRiemannIntegral.iff_hasIntegral

  simp [HasRiemannIntegral, hab, HasStieltjesIntegral.of_lt, HasStieltjesIntegralOrdered,

name: riemannIntegral.integral_undef
statement:
@[simp]

name: succ_n_eq
statement: theorem succ_n_eq (p q : Q n.succ) : p = q ↔ p 0 = q 0 ∧ π p = π q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₀, h⟩
    ext x
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · rwa [hx]
    · rw [← Fin.succ_pred x hx]
      convert! congr_fun h (Fin.pred x hx)

name: not_adjacent_zero
statement: theorem not_adjacent_zero (p q : Q 0) : q ∉ p.adjacent
proof: := by rintro ⟨v, _⟩; apply finZeroElim v

name: adj_iff_proj_eq
statement: theorem adj_iff_proj_eq {p q : Q n.succ} (h₀ : p 0 ≠ q 0) : q ∈ p.adjacent ↔ π p = π q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, _, h_uni⟩
    ext x; by_contra hx
    apply Fin.succ_ne_zero x
    rw [h_uni _ hx, h_uni _ h₀]
  · intro heq
    use 0, h₀
    intro y hy
    contrapose! hy
    rw [← Fin.succ_pred _ hy]
    apply congr_fun heq

name: adj_iff_proj_adj
statement:
theorem adj_iff_proj_adj {p q : Q n.succ} (h₀ : p 0 = q 0) :
    q ∈ p.adjacent ↔ π q ∈ (π p).adjacent
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, h_eq, h_uni⟩
    have h_i : i ≠ 0 := fun h_i => absurd h₀ (by rwa [h_i] at h_eq)
    use i.pred h_i,
      show p (Fin.succ (Fin.pred i _)) ≠ q (Fin.succ (Fin.pred i _)) by rwa [Fin.succ_pred]
    intro y hy
    simp [Eq.symm (h_uni _ hy)]
  · rintro ⟨i, h_eq, h_uni⟩
    use i.succ, h_eq
    intro y hy
    rw [← Fin.pred_inj (ha := (?ha : y ≠ 0)) (hb := (?hb : i.succ ≠ 0)),
      Fin.pred_succ]
    case ha =>
      contrapose hy
      rw [hy, h₀]
    case hb =>
      apply Fin.succ_ne_zero
    apply h_uni
    simp [π, hy]

name: duality
statement: theorem duality (p q : Q n) : ε p (e q) = if p = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Subsingleton.elim (α := Q 0) p q, ε, e]
  | succ n IH =>
    dsimp [ε, e]
    cases hp : p 0 <;> cases hq : q 0
    all_goals
      simp only [Bool.cond_true, Bool.cond_false, LinearMap.fst_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply,
        LinearMap.comp_apply, IH]
      congr 1; simp [Q.succ_n_eq, hp, hq]

name: epsilon_total
statement: theorem epsilon_total {v : V n} (h : ∀ p : Q n, (ε p) v = 0) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => dsimp [ε] at h; exact h fun _ => true
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ := v
    ext <;> change _ = (0 : V n) <;> simp only <;> apply ih <;> intro p <;>
      [let q : Q n.succ := fun i => if h : i = 0 then true else p (i.pred h);
      let q : Q n.succ := fun i => if h : i = 0 then false else p (i.pred h)]
    all_goals
      specialize h q
      first
      | rw [ε, show q 0 = true from rfl, Bool.cond_true] at h
      | rw [ε, show q 0 = false from rfl, Bool.cond_false] at h
      rwa [show p = π q by ext; simp [q, Fin.succ_ne_zero, π]]

  total h := sub_eq_zero.mp <| epsilon_total fun i ↦ by

  | zero => simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul, f_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: f_matrix
statement: theorem f_matrix (p q : Q n) : |ε q (f n (e p))| = if p ∈ q.adjacent then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    dsimp [f]
    simp [Q.not_adjacent_zero]
    rfl
  | succ n IH =>
    have ite_nonneg : ite (π q = π p) (1 : ℝ) 0 ≥ 0 := by split_ifs <;> norm_num
    dsimp only [e, ε, f, V]; rw [LinearMap.prod_apply]; dsimp; cases hp : p 0 <;> cases hq : q 0
    all_goals
      repeat rw [Bool.cond_true]
      repeat rw [Bool.cond_false]
      simp [hp, hq, IH, duality, abs_of_nonneg ite_nonneg, Q.adj_iff_proj_eq,
        Q.adj_iff_proj_adj]

name: g_injective

name: f_image_g
statement: theorem f_image_g (w : V m.succ) (hv : ∃ v, g m v = w) : f m.succ w = √(m + 1) • w
proof:
:= by
  rcases hv with ⟨v, rfl⟩
  have : √(m + 1) * √(m + 1) = m + 1 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (mod_cast zero_le)
  rw [f_succ_apply, g_apply]
  simp [this, f_squared, smul_add, add_smul, smul_smul]
  abel

name: exists_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue (H : Set (Q m.succ)) (hH : Card H ≥ 2 ^ m + 1) :
    ∃ y ∈ Span (e '' H) ⊓ range (g m), y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let W := Span (e '' H)
  let img := range (g m)
  suffices 0 < dim (W ⊓ img) by
    exact mod_cast exists_mem_ne_zero_of_rank_pos this
  have dim_le : dim (W ⊔ img) ≤ 2 ^ (m + 1 : Cardinal) := by
    convert! ← Submodule.rank_le (W ⊔ img)
    rw [← Nat.cast_succ]
    apply dim_V
  have dim_add : dim (W ⊔ img) + dim (W ⊓ img) = dim W + 2 ^ m := by
    convert! ← Submodule.rank_sup_add_rank_inf_eq W img
    rw [rank_range_of_injective (g m) g_injective]
    apply dim_V
  have dimW : dim W = card H := by
    have li : LinearIndependent ℝ (H.domRestrict e) := by
      convert! (dualBases_e_ε m.succ).basis.linearIndependent.comp _ Subtype.val_injective
      rw [(dualBases_e_ε _).coe_basis]
      rfl
    have hdW := rank_span li
    rw [Set.range_domRestrict] at hdW
    convert! hdW
    rw [← (dualBases_e_ε _).coe_basis, Cardinal.mk_image_eq (dualBases_e_ε _).basis.injective,
      Cardinal.mk_fintype]
  rw [← finrank_eq_rank ℝ] at dim_le dim_add dimW ⊢
  rw [← finrank_eq_rank ℝ, ← finrank_eq_rank ℝ] at dim_add
  norm_cast at dim_le dim_add dimW ⊢
  rw [pow_succ'] at dim_le
  rw [Set.toFinset_card] at hH
  linarith

name: huang_degree_theorem
statement:
theorem huang_degree_theorem (H : Set (Q m.succ)) (hH : Card H ≥ 2 ^ m + 1) :
    ∃ q, q ∈ H ∧ √(m + 1) ≤ Card H ∩ q.adjacent
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_eigenvalue H hH with ⟨y, ⟨⟨y_mem_H, y_mem_g⟩, y_ne⟩⟩
  have coeffs_support : ((dualBases_e_ε m.succ).coeffs y).support ⊆ H.toFinset := by
    intro p p_in
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at p_in
    rw [Set.mem_toFinset]
    exact (dualBases_e_ε _).mem_of_mem_span y_mem_H p p_in
  obtain ⟨q, H_max⟩ : ∃ q : Q m.succ, ∀ q' : Q m.succ, |(ε q' :) y| ≤ |ε q y| :=
    Finite.exists_max _
  have H_q_pos : 0 < |ε q y| := by
    contrapose! y_ne
    exact epsilon_total fun p => abs_nonpos_iff.mp (le_trans (H_max p) y_ne)
  refine ⟨q, (dualBases_e_ε _).mem_of_mem_span y_mem_H q (abs_pos.mp H_q_pos), ?_⟩
  let s := √(m + 1)
  suffices s * |ε q y| ≤ _ * |ε q y| from (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ H_q_pos).mp ‹_›
  let coeffs := (dualBases_e_ε m.succ).coeffs
  calc
    s * |ε q y| = |ε q (s • y)| := by
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    _ = |ε q (f m.succ y)| := by rw [← f_image_g y (by simpa using! y_mem_g)]
    _ = |ε q (f m.succ (lc _ (coeffs y)))| := by rw [(dualBases_e_ε _).lc_coeffs y]
    _ =
        |(coeffs y).sum fun (i : Q m.succ) (a : ℝ) =>
            a • (ε q ∘ f m.succ ∘ fun i : Q m.succ => e i) i| := by
      rw [lc_def, (f m.succ).map_finsupp_linearCombination, (ε q).map_finsupp_linearCombination,
           Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ (coeffs y).support, |coeffs y p * (ε q <| f m.succ <| e p)| :=
      (norm_sum_le _ fun p => coeffs y p * _)
    _ = ∑ p ∈ (coeffs y).support, |coeffs y p| * ite (p ∈ q.adjacent) 1 0 := by
      simp only [abs_mul, f_matrix]
    _ = ∑ p ∈ (coeffs y).support with p ∈ q.adjacent, |coeffs y p| := by
      simp [sum_filter]
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ (coeffs y).support with p ∈ q.adjacent, |coeffs y q| := sum_le_sum fun p _ ↦ H_max p
    _ = #{p ∈ (coeffs y).support | p ∈ q.adjacent} * |coeffs y q| := by
      rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ = #((coeffs y).support ∩ q.adjacent.toFinset) * |coeffs y q| := by
      congr with x; simp
    _ ≤ #(H ∩ q.adjacent).toFinset * |ε q y| := by
      refine (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ H_q_pos).2 ?_
      norm_cast
      apply card_le_card
      rw [Set.toFinset_inter]
      convert! inter_subset_inter_right coeffs_support

name: zagierSet_lower_bound
statement: lemma zagierSet_lower_bound {x y z : ℕ} (h : (x, y, z) ∈ zagierSet k) : 0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z
proof:
:= by
  rw [zagierSet, mem_ofPred_eq] at h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals
    by_contra q
    rw [not_lt, nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at q
    simp only [q, mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, add_zero] at h
  · apply_fun (· % 4) at h
    simp [mul_assoc, Nat.add_mod] at h
  all_goals
    rcases (Nat.dvd_prime hk.out).1 (dvd_of_mul_left_eq _ h) with e | e
    all_goals
      simp only [e, right_eq_add, ne_eq, add_eq_zero, and_false, not_false_eq_true,
        mul_eq_left₀, reduceCtorEq] at h
      simp only [h, zero_add] at hk
      exact Nat.not_prime_one hk.out

name: zagierSet_upper_bound

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _⟩ := zagierSet_lower_bound k h
  rw [zagierSet, mem_ofPred_eq] at h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> nlinarith

name: zagierSet_subset

proof:
:= by

  have lb := zagierSet_lower_bound k h
  have ub := zagierSet_upper_bound k h
  exact ⟨⟨lb.1, ub.1⟩, ⟨lb.2.1, ub.2.1⟩, ⟨lb.2.2, ub.2.2⟩⟩

name: obvInvo_sq
statement: theorem obvInvo_sq : obvInvo k ^ 2 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: sq_add_sq_of_nonempty_fixedPoints
statement:
theorem sq_add_sq_of_nonempty_fixedPoints (hn : (fixedPoints (obvInvo k)).Nonempty) :
    ∃ a b : ℕ, a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 4 * k + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sq]
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, y, z⟩, he⟩, hf⟩ := hn
  have := mem_fixedPoints_iff.mp hf
  simp only [obvInvo, Subtype.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and] at this
  simp only [zagierSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at he
  use x, (2 * y)
  rw [show 2 * y * (2 * y) = 4 * y * y by linarith, ← he, this.1]

name: complexInvo_sq
statement: theorem complexInvo_sq : complexInvo k ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  change complexInvo k ∘ complexInvo k = id
  funext ⟨⟨x, y, z⟩, h⟩
  rw [comp_apply]
  obtain ⟨xb, _, _⟩ := zagierSet_lower_bound k h
  conv_lhs => arg 2; simp only [complexInvo]
  split_ifs with less more <;> rw [complexInvo, Subtype.mk.injEq, id_eq]
  · 
    simp only [show ¬(x + 2 * z + (y - x - z) < z) by linarith [less], ite_false,
      lt_add_iff_pos_left, xb, add_tsub_cancel_right, ite_true]
    rw [Nat.sub_sub, two_mul, ← tsub_add_eq_add_tsub (by linarith), ← add_assoc,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel, add_comm (x + z), Nat.sub_add_cancel less.le]
  · 
    push Not at less
    simp only [show x - 2 * y + y < x + z - y by zify [less, more.le]; linarith, ite_true]
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel more.le, Nat.sub_right_comm, Nat.sub_sub _ _ y, ← two_mul, add_comm,
      Nat.add_sub_assoc more.le, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  · 
    push Not at less more
    simp only [show ¬(2 * y - x + (x + z - y) < y) by zify [less, more]; linarith,
      show ¬(2 * y < 2 * y - x) by zify [more]; linarith, ite_false]
    rw [tsub_tsub_assoc (2 * y).le_refl more, tsub_self, zero_add,
      ← Nat.add_sub_assoc less, ← add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel more, Nat.sub_sub _ _ y,
      ← two_mul, add_comm, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: eq_of_mem_fixedPoints
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_fixedPoints {t : zagierSet k} (mem : t ∈ fixedPoints (complexInvo k)) :
    t.val = (1, 1, k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, y, z⟩, h⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨_, _, _⟩ := zagierSet_lower_bound k h
  rw [mem_fixedPoints_iff, complexInvo, Subtype.mk.injEq] at mem
  split_ifs at mem with less more <;>
    
    simp_all only [not_lt, Prod.mk.injEq, add_eq_left, mul_eq_zero, false_or,
      lt_self_iff_false, reduceCtorEq]
  · 
    obtain ⟨_, _, _⟩ := mem; simp_all
  · 
    simp only [zagierSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h
    replace mem := mem.1
    rw [tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le more, ← two_mul] at mem
    replace mem := (mul_left_cancel₀ two_ne_zero mem).symm
    subst mem
    rw [show x * x + 4 * x * z = x * (x + 4 * z) by linarith] at h
    rcases (Nat.dvd_prime hk.out).1 (dvd_of_mul_left_eq _ h) with e | e
    · rw [e, mul_one] at h
      simp_all [show z = 0 by linarith [e]]
    · simp only [e, mul_left_eq_self₀, add_eq_zero, and_false, or_false, reduceCtorEq] at h
      simp only [h, true_and]
      linarith [e]

name: card_fixedPoints_eq_one
statement: theorem card_fixedPoints_eq_one : Fintype.card (fixedPoints (complexInvo k)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 1 = Finset.card (singletonFixedPoint k) by rfl, ← Set.toFinset_card]
  congr
  rw [singletonFixedPoint, Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem]
  constructor
  · simp [IsFixedPt, complexInvo]
  · intro _ mem
    simp only [Set.mem_toFinset] at mem
    replace mem := eq_of_mem_fixedPoints k mem
    congr!

name: Nat.Prime.sq_add_sq'
statement:
theorem Nat.Prime.sq_add_sq' {p : ℕ} [h : Fact p.Prime] (hp : p % 4 = 1) :
    ∃ a b : ℕ, a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← div_add_mod p 4, hp] at h ⊢
  let k := p / 4
  apply sq_add_sq_of_nonempty_fixedPoints
  have key := (Equiv.Perm.card_fixedPoints_modEq (p := 2) (n := 1) (obvInvo_sq k)).symm.trans
    (Equiv.Perm.card_fixedPoints_modEq (p := 2) (n := 1) (complexInvo_sq k))
  contrapose key
  rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at key
  simp_rw [k, key, Fintype.card_eq_zero, card_fixedPoints_eq_one]
  decide

name: integrable_eval_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_eval_mul (p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ)
    (f : ContDiffSupportedOn ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) ℝ ⊤ (closedBall 0 1)) :
    Integrable fun (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) ↦ eval x p * f x
proof:
:=
  (p.continuous_eval.comp (continuous_ofLp 2 _)).mul
    (ContDiffSupportedOn.contDiff f).continuous
    |>.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hasCompactSupport f).mul_left

name: inj_L
statement: lemma inj_L : Injective (L ι)
proof:
:=
  (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun p hp ↦ by
    have H : ∀ᵐ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, x ∈ ball 0 1 → eval x p = 0 :=
      isOpen_ball.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero
        (p.continuous_eval.comp (continuous_ofLp 2 _)
          |>.locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn _)
        fun g hg _h2g g_supp ↦ by
          simpa [mul_comm (g _), L] using congr($hp ⟨g, g_supp.trans ball_subset_closedBall, hg⟩)
    simp_rw [MvPolynomial.funext_iff, map_zero]
    refine fun x ↦ AnalyticOnNhd.eval_linearMap (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℝ).toLinearMap p
      |>.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
      (preconnectedSpace_iff_univ.mp inferInstance) (z₀ := 0) trivial
      (Filter.mem_of_superset (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 zero_lt_one) ?_) trivial
    rw [← ae_restrict_iff'₀ measurableSet_ball.nullMeasurableSet] at H
    apply Measure.eqOn_of_ae_eq H
      (p.continuous_eval.comp (continuous_ofLp 2 _)).continuousOn continuousOn_const
    rw [isOpen_ball.interior_eq]
    apply subset_closure

name: hairer
statement:
lemma hairer (N : ℕ) (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] :
    ∃ (ρ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ), tsupport ρ ⊆ closedBall 0 1 ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ ∧
    ∀ (p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ), p.totalDegree ≤ N →
    ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, eval x p • ρ x = eval 0 p
proof:
:= by
  have := (inj_L ι).comp (restrictTotalDegree ι ℝ N).injective_subtype
  rw [← LinearMap.coe_comp] at this
  obtain ⟨⟨φ, supφ, difφ⟩, hφ⟩ :=
    LinearMap.flip_surjective_iff₁.2 this ((aeval 0).toLinearMap.comp <| Submodule.subtype _)
  exact ⟨φ, supφ, difφ, fun P hP ↦ congr($hφ ⟨P, (mem_restrictTotalDegree ι N P).mpr hP⟩)⟩

name: smul1
statement: private lemma smul1 : 1 • a = a
proof: := rfl

name: smul2
statement: private lemma smul2 : 2 • a = a + a
proof: := rfl

name: smul3
statement: private lemma smul3 : 3 • a = a + a + a
proof: := rfl

name: smul4
statement: private lemma smul4 : 4 • a = a + a + a + a
proof: := rfl

name: smul5
statement: private lemma smul5 : 5 • a = a + a + a + a + a
proof: := rfl

name: smul_succ
statement: lemma smul_succ {k : ℕ} {a : α} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (k + 1) • a = k • a + a
proof:
:= by
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction <;> rfl

name: mann_44
statement: lemma mann_44 : -(-(-(a + b) + -a + b) + b) = -(a + b)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← robbins (-(a + b)) (-a + b)]
  nth_rw 3 [← robbins b a]
  congr 2 <;> ac_rfl

name: mann_45
statement: lemma mann_45 : -(-(-(-a + b) + a + b) + b) = -(-a + b)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← robbins (-(-a + b)) (a + b)]
  nth_rw 3 [← robbins b a]
  ac_rfl

name: mann_46
statement: lemma mann_46 : -(-(-(-a + b) + a + b + b) + -(-a + b)) = b
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← robbins b (-(-a + b) + a + b)]
  nth_rw 2 [← mann_45 a b]
  ac_rfl

name: mann_47
proof:
:= by
  set w := -(-(-a + b) + a + b + b) + -(-a + b)
  nth_rw 3 [← robbins c w]
  rw [mann_46 a b]
  ac_rfl

name: mann_48
proof:
:= by
  have key := robbins (-(b + c)) (-(-(-a + b) + a + b + b) + -(-a + b) + c)
  set q := -(-(-(-a + b) + a + b + b) + -(-a + b) + c)
  conv_rhs => rw [← key, add_comm _ q, mann_47]
  ac_rfl

name: mann_49
proof:
:= by
  set w := -(-(-(-a + b) + a + b + b) + -(-a + b) + -(b + c) + c) + c
  nth_rw 3 [← robbins d w]
  rw [mann_48 a b c]
  ac_rfl

name: mann_50
statement: lemma mann_50 : -(-(q a + -(3 • a)) + -(q a + 5 • a)) = q a
proof:
:= by
  have k₁ := mann_44 (3 • a) (q a + 2 • a)
  have rearr₁ : -(-(3 • a + (q a + 2 • a)) + -(3 • a) + (q a + 2 • a)) + (q a + 2 • a) =
      -(-(q a + 5 • a) + -(3 • a) + (q a + 2 • a)) + 2 • a + q a := by
    rw [smul2, smul3, smul5]
    ac_rfl
  rw [rearr₁] at k₁
  have k₂ : -(-(-(-(q a + 3 • a + a + a) + q a + -(a + 2 • a) + 2 • a) + 2 • a + q a) +
      -(-(a + 2 • a) + q a)) = q a := mann_49 (3 • a) a (2 • a) (q a)
  have rearr₂ : (-(q a + 3 • a + a + a) + q a + -(a + 2 • a) + 2 • a) =
      -(q a + 5 • a) + -(3 • a) + (q a + 2 • a) := by
    simp_rw [smul2, smul3, smul5, ← add_assoc]
    congr 2
    simp_rw [add_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [add_comm]
  rw [rearr₂, k₁] at k₂
  convert k₂ using 2
  rw [smul2, smul3, smul5]
  ac_rfl

name: mann_51
statement: lemma mann_51 : -(q a + 5 • a) = -(3 • a)
proof:
:= by
  have k₁ := robbins (-(q a + 5 • a)) (q a + -(3 • a))
  have k₂ : -(-(q a + -(3 • a)) + -(q a + 5 • a)) = q a := mann_50 a
  have k₃ : -(-(-(q a + 3 • a + a + a) + q a + -(3 • a)) + q a) = -(3 • a) := by
    convert! mann_47 (3 • a) a (-(3 • a)) using 3
    rw [q, add_comm]
  rw [← k₃, ← k₁, ← add_comm (-(q a + _)), k₂]
  simp_rw [smul3, smul5, ← add_assoc]

name: mann_52
proof:
:= by
  have key := robbins (q a + 2 • a) (3 • a)
  have rearr : q a + 2 • a + 3 • a = q a + 5 • a := by
    rw [smul2, smul3, smul5]
    ac_rfl
  rw [← key, rearr, mann_51]
  ac_rfl

name: mann_53
statement: lemma mann_53 : -(q a + -(3 • a)) = a
proof:
:= by
  have k₁ := robbins a (q a + 4 • a)
  have rearr : a + (q a + 4 • a) = q a + 5 • a := by
    rw [smul4, smul5]
    ac_rfl
  rw [rearr, mann_51] at k₁
  have k₂ : -(-(q a + 3 • a + a) + a) = q a := mann_45 (3 • a) a
  have rearr₂ : -(q a + 3 • a + a) + a = a + -(q a + 4 • a) := by
    rw [smul3, smul4]
    ac_rfl
  rw [rearr₂] at k₂
  rw [k₂] at k₁
  rwa [add_comm]

name: mann_54
statement: lemma mann_54 : -(-(q a + -(3 • a) + b) + -(a + b)) = b
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← robbins b (q a + -(3 • a)), mann_53]
  ac_rfl

name: winker
statement: theorem winker : ∃ x y : α, x + y = y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨q default, 2 • default, ?_⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [← mann_52]
  conv_rhs => rw [← mann_54 default (2 • default)]
  simp_rw [smul2, smul3, ← add_assoc]

name: mann_33
statement: lemma mann_33 (h : -(a + -(b + c)) = -(a + b + -c)) : a + b = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← robbins (a + b) c, ← h, add_assoc, robbins]

name: mann_34
statement: lemma mann_34 (h : -(a + -(b + c)) = -(b + -(a + c))) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← robbins a (b + c), h, show a + (b + c) = b + (a + c) by ac_rfl, robbins]

name: mann_35
statement: lemma mann_35 (h : -(a + -b) = c) : -(-(a + b) + c) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h, robbins]

name: mann_36
statement: lemma mann_36 (hk : 1 ≤ k) (h : -(a + -b) = c) : -(a + -(b + k • (a + c))) = c
proof:
:= by
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    nth_rw 1 [smul1, ← mann_35 h]
    conv_rhs => rw [← robbins c (a + b)]
    ac_rfl
  | succ k lk ih =>
    nth_rw 1 [smul_succ lk, ← mann_35 ih]
    conv_rhs => rw [← robbins c (a + b + k • (a + c))]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr 2 <;> ac_rfl

name: mann_37
proof:
:= by
  set c := -(a + -b)
  have aux := mann_36 hk h
  rw [add_comm c a] at aux
  set bk := b + k • (a + c)
  apply mann_34 (c := c)
  rw [add_comm (-b), h, add_comm _ c, aux, add_comm _ a, mann_36 hk rfl, add_comm]

name: mann_38
statement: lemma mann_38 (hk : 1 ≤ k) (h : -(a + b) = -b) : -(b + k • (a + -(a + -b))) = -b
proof:
:= by
  apply mann_37 hk
  nth_rw 2 [← robbins a b, ← h]
  ac_rfl

name: mann_39
statement: lemma mann_39 (h₂ : -(2 • a + b) = -b) (h₃ : -(3 • a + b) = -b) : 2 • a + b = 3 • a + b
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs at h₃ => rw [← h₂]
  rw [smul_succ (by lia), show 2 • a + a + b = a + (2 • a + b) by ac_rfl] at h₃
  have e₁ := mann_38 le_rfl h₂
  have e₂ := mann_38 le_rfl h₃
  rw [smul1] at e₁ e₂
  rw [show b + (2 • a + -(2 • a + -b)) = 2 • a + b + -(a + (a + -b)) by rw [smul2]; ac_rfl] at e₁
  rw [h₂] at e₂
  conv_rhs at e₁ => rw [← e₂, ← add_assoc]
  rw [← mann_33 e₁]
  rw [smul2, smul3]
  ac_rfl

name: mann_40
proof:
:= by
  suffices -(b + 2 • (a + -(a + -b))) = -b ∧ -(b + 3 • (a + -(a + -b))) = -b by
    rw [add_comm b, add_comm b] at this
    replace this := mann_39 this.1 this.2
    rwa [add_comm b, add_comm b]
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact ⟨mann_38 (by lia) h, mann_38 (by lia) h⟩
  · exact ⟨mann_37 (by lia) h, mann_37 (by lia) h⟩

name: exists_idempotent
statement: theorem exists_idempotent : ∃ x : α, x + x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ := winker (α := α)
  let c := b + 2 • -(a + -b)
  have k₁ : a + c = c := by
    unfold c
    rw [← add_assoc, h]
  have k₂ : -b = -c := by
    rw [← mann_38 (show 1 ≤ 2 by lia) (congrArg (-·) h), smul2,
      show b + (a + -(a + -b) + (a + -(a + -b))) = a + (a + b) + (-(a + -b) + -(a + -b)) by ac_rfl,
      h, h, ← smul2]
  have k₃ : c + -(a + -c) = c := by
    rw [← k₂]
    conv_lhs => simp only [c]
    nth_rw 1 [add_assoc, smul2, ← h, ← h, ← h,
      show a + (a + (a + b)) + (-(a + -b) + -(a + -b) + -(a + -b)) =
        b + ((a + -(a + -b)) + (a + -(a + -b)) + (a + -(a + -b))) by ac_rfl,
      ← smul3, ← mann_40 (.inl (by rw [h])), smul2,
      show b + (a + -(a + -b) + (a + -(a + -b))) =
        a + (a + b) + (-(a + -b) + -(a + -b)) by ac_rfl, ← smul2, h, h]
  have k₄ : -(-(c + -c) + -c) = c := by
    nth_rw 4 [← robbins c (a + -c)]
    nth_rw 3 [← k₃]
    nth_rw 1 [← k₁]
    ac_rfl
  replace k₄ := mann_40 (.inr k₄)
  set d := c + -(c + -c)
  have fin : 3 • d + d = 2 • d + d := by
    change _ + (c + -(c + -c)) = _ + (c + -(c + -c))
    simp_rw [← add_assoc]
    rw [add_comm (2 • d), k₄, add_comm (3 • d)]
  use 3 • d
  nth_rw 2 [smul3]
  rw [← add_assoc, ← add_assoc _ d]
  iterate 3 rw [fin, ← smul_succ (by lia)]

name: exists_zero
statement: theorem exists_zero : ∃ z : α, ∀ a, a + z = a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_idempotent (α := α)
  refine ⟨-(a + -a), fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  set z := -(a + -a)
  have k₁ : a = -(-a + z) := by nth_rw 1 [← robbins a a, ha]
  have k₂ (x) : a + x = -(-(a + x) + -(a + x + -a)) := by
    nth_rw 1 [← robbins (a + x) a, show a + x + a = a + a + x by ac_rfl, ha]
  have k₃ (x) : x = -(-(x + -a + z) + -(x + a)) := by
    nth_rw 1 [← robbins x (-a + z), ← k₁, add_assoc]
  have k₄ : -a = -(-(a + -a + -a) + a) := by
    nth_rw 1 [← robbins (-a) (a + -a), ← k₁]
    ac_rfl
  have k₅ : a = -(-(a + -a + z) + -a) := by nth_rw 1 [k₃ a, ha]
  have k₆ : a = -(-(a + -a + -a) + -a) := by
    nth_rw 1 [← robbins a (a + -a + -a), add_comm a (-(_ + _)), ← k₄, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc, ha]
  have k₇ : -(a + -a + -a) = z := by rw [← robbins (-(a + -a + -a)) a, ← k₄, ← k₆, add_comm]
  have k₈ : -a = -(a + z) := by rw [k₄, k₇, add_comm]
  have k₉ : a + z = a := by
    rw [k₂ z, ← k₈]
    conv_rhs => rw [k₅]
    ac_rfl
  nth_rw 2 [k₃ x]
  rw [← robbins (x + z) a, add_assoc, add_comm z, k₉]
  ac_rfl

name: neg_neg
statement: theorem neg_neg : - -a = a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_zero (α := α)
  have k₁ (x) : z = -(-x + - -x) := by rw [← robbins z x, add_comm z, hz, add_comm z, hz]
  have k₂ (x : α) : -x = - -(-x + - - -x) := by
    nth_rw 1 [← robbins (-x) (- -x), ← k₁, add_comm z, hz]
  have k₃ (x : α) : - - -x = -x := by
    nth_rw 1 [← robbins (- - -x) (-x), add_comm _ (- -x), ← k₁ (-x), hz, add_comm, ← k₂]
  simpa only [robbins] using k₃ (-(a + z) + -(a + -z))

name: huntington
statement: theorem huntington : -(-a + -b) + -(-a + b) = a
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← neg_neg a, ← robbins (-a) b, neg_neg, add_comm]

name: add_neg_self_const
statement: lemma add_neg_self_const : a + -a = b + -b
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← huntington (-b) (-a), ← huntington b (-a),
    ← huntington (-a) (-b), ← huntington a (-b)]
  ac_rfl

name: neg_zero
statement: lemma neg_zero : -(0 : α) = 1
proof: := neg_neg _

name: neg_one
statement: lemma neg_one : -(1 : α) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: add_neg_self
statement: lemma add_neg_self : a + -a = 1
proof: := add_neg_self_const ..

name: add_zero
statement: lemma add_zero : a + 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  have l₀ := huntington (0 : α) 0
  rw [add_comm _ 0, add_neg_self, neg_zero, ← neg_one] at l₀
  have l₁ := add_neg_self (1 : α)
  rw [← l₀, add_comm, add_assoc, add_comm (-1), add_neg_self] at l₁
  have s₁ := add_neg_self (1 + 1 : α)
  rw [add_assoc, add_comm _ (-_), l₁] at s₁
  have s₀ := neg_one (α := α)
  rw [← l₀, s₁, neg_one] at s₀
  rw [← huntington a a, add_comm _ a, add_neg_self, neg_one, add_assoc, s₀]

name: add_self
statement: lemma add_self : a + a = a
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← neg_neg a, ← huntington (-a) (-a)]
  rw [add_comm _ (-a), add_neg_self, neg_one, add_zero, neg_neg, neg_neg]

name: min_add_left
statement: lemma min_add_left : -(-a + -b) + a = a
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← huntington a b]
  rw [← add_assoc, add_self, huntington]

name: min_add_distrib
statement: lemma min_add_distrib : -(-a + -(b + c)) = -(-a + -b) + -(-a + -c)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← huntington (-_) b, neg_neg, add_assoc, ← neg_neg b, ← neg_neg c, min_add_left,
    ← huntington (-_) c, ← huntington (-(_ + b)) c]
  have l₁ := huntington (-(-a + -b)) c
  have l₂ := huntington (-(-a + -c)) b
  simp only [neg_neg] at l₁ l₂ ⊢
  rw [show -a + -(b + c) + b + -c = -a + b + (-(c + b) + -c) by ac_rfl,
    show -a + -(b + c) + b + c = -a + ((b + c) + -(b + c)) by ac_rfl]
  conv_lhs => enter [2, 1, 1, 2, 1]; rw [← neg_neg b, ← neg_neg c]
  rw [min_add_left, add_neg_self_const _ a, show -a + (a + -a) = a + (-a + -a) by ac_rfl, add_self,
    add_neg_self, neg_one, add_zero, ← add_self (-_), add_assoc (-_), l₁, ← l₂]
  ac_rfl

name: add_min_distrib
statement: lemma add_min_distrib : a + -(-b + -c) = -(-(a + b) + -(a + c))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [neg_neg] using congr(-$(min_add_distrib (-a) (-b) (-c)))

name: stateEq_implies_write_eq
statement:
theorem stateEq_implies_write_eq {t : Register} {ζ₁ ζ₂ : State} (h : ζ₁ ≃[t] ζ₂) (v : Word) :
    write t v ζ₁ ≃[t + 1] write t v ζ₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [StateEq, StateEqRs, write] at *
  constructor; · exact h.1
  intro r hr
  have hr : r ≤ t := Register.le_of_lt_succ hr
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hr with hr | hr
  · obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
    specialize h r hr
    simp_all
  · simp_all

name: stateEqRs_implies_write_eq_rs
statement:
theorem stateEqRs_implies_write_eq_rs {t : Register} {ζ₁ ζ₂ : State} (h : ζ₁ ≃[t]/ac ζ₂)
    (r : Register) (v : Word) : write r v ζ₁ ≃[t]/ac write r v ζ₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [StateEqRs, write] at *
  intro r' hr'
  specialize h r' hr'
  congr

name: write_eq_implies_stateEq
statement:
theorem write_eq_implies_stateEq {t : Register} {v : Word} {ζ₁ ζ₂ : State}
    (h : ζ₁ ≃[t + 1] write t v ζ₂) : ζ₁ ≃[t] ζ₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [StateEq, write, StateEqRs] at *
  constructor; · exact h.1
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
  specialize h r (lt_trans hr (Register.lt_succ_self _))
  rwa [ite_eq_right (ne_of_lt hr)] at h

name: compiler_correctness
statement:
theorem compiler_correctness
    (map : Identifier → Register) (e : Expr) (ξ : Identifier → Word) (η : State) (t : Register)
    (hmap : ∀ x, read (loc x map) η = ξ x) (ht : ∀ x, loc x map < t) :
    outcome (compile map e t) η ≃[t] { η with ac := value e ξ }
proof:
:= by
  induction e generalizing η t with
  
  | const => simp [StateEq, step]; rfl
  
  | var =>
    simp_all [StateEq, StateEqRs, step]
  
  | sum =>
    rename_i e_s₁ e_s₂ e_ih_s₁ e_ih_s₂
    simp only [compile, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, outcome_append, outcome, value]
    generalize value e_s₁ ξ = ν₁ at e_ih_s₁ ⊢
    generalize value e_s₂ ξ = ν₂ at e_ih_s₂ ⊢
    generalize dν : ν₁ + ν₂ = ν
    generalize dζ₁ : outcome (compile _ e_s₁ t) η = ζ₁
    generalize dζ₂ : step (Instruction.sto t) ζ₁ = ζ₂
    generalize dζ₃ : outcome (compile _ e_s₂ (t + 1)) ζ₂ = ζ₃
    generalize dζ₄ : step (Instruction.add t) ζ₃ = ζ₄
    have hζ₁ : ζ₁ ≃[t] { η with ac := ν₁ } := calc
      ζ₁ = outcome (compile map e_s₁ t) η := by simp_all
      _ ≃[t] { η with ac := ν₁ } := by apply e_ih_s₁ <;> assumption
    have hζ₁_ν₁ : ζ₁.ac = ν₁ := by simp_all [StateEq]
    have hζ₂ : ζ₂ ≃[t + 1]/ac write t ν₁ η := calc
      ζ₂ = step (Instruction.sto t) ζ₁ := by simp_all
      _ = write t ζ₁.ac ζ₁ := by simp [step]
      _ = write t ν₁ ζ₁ := by simp_all
      _ ≃[t + 1] write t ν₁ { η with ac := ν₁ } := by apply stateEq_implies_write_eq hζ₁
      _ ≃[t + 1]/ac write t ν₁ η := by
        apply stateEqRs_implies_write_eq_rs
        simp [StateEqRs]
    have ht' : ∀ x, loc x map < t + 1 := by
      intros
      apply lt_trans (ht _) (Register.lt_succ_self _)
    have hmap' : ∀ x, read (loc x map) ζ₂ = ξ x := by
      intro x
      calc
        read (loc x map) ζ₂ = read (loc x map) (write t ν₁ η) := hζ₂ _ (ht' _)
        _ = read (loc x map) η := by simp only [loc] at ht; simp [(ht _).ne]
        _ = ξ x := hmap x
    have hζ₃ : ζ₃ ≃[t + 1] { write t ν₁ η with ac := ν₂ } := calc
      ζ₃ = outcome (compile map e_s₂ (t + 1)) ζ₂ := by simp_all
      _ ≃[t + 1] { ζ₂ with ac := ν₂ } := by apply e_ih_s₂ <;> assumption
      _ ≃[t + 1] { write t ν₁ η with ac := ν₂ } := by simpa [StateEq]
    have hζ₃_ν₂ : ζ₃.ac = ν₂ := by simp_all [StateEq]
    have hζ₃_ν₁ : read t ζ₃ = ν₁ := by
      simp only [StateEq, StateEqRs, write, read] at hζ₃ ⊢
      obtain ⟨_, hζ₃⟩ := hζ₃
      specialize hζ₃ t (Register.lt_succ_self _)
      simp_all
    have hζ₄ : ζ₄ ≃[t + 1] { write t ν₁ η with ac := ν } := calc
      ζ₄ = step (Instruction.add t) ζ₃ := by simp_all
      _ = { ζ₃ with ac := read t ζ₃ + ζ₃.ac } := by simp [step]
      _ = { ζ₃ with ac := ν } := by simp_all
      _ ≃[t + 1] { { write t ν₁ η with ac := ν₂ } with ac := ν } := by
        simp only [StateEq, true_and]; exact hζ₃.2
      _ ≃[t + 1] { write t ν₁ η with ac := ν } := by simp_all; rfl
    apply write_eq_implies_stateEq <;> assumption
